name: Mapillary Vistas: Street-Level Scene Understanding Benchmark
description: A diverse, global street-level imagery benchmark dataset created by Mapillary (Meta) for fine-grained semantic, instance, and panoptic scene understanding. Comprises 25,000 high-resolution street view photographs captured across six continents using diverse imaging devices (smartphones, action cams, professional panoramic cameras) under variable weather, lighting, and season conditions. Version 2.0 features pixel-accurate annotations across 124 semantic categories including roads, sidewalks, traffic signs, curbs, vehicles, and pedestrians.
